Schema:
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "title": "Scene",
  "description": "A Scene defines a set of properties and Elements to be shared among multile Pages. It also defines a background music to be played when one of those Pages is active.\nA Page is always associated with a Scene, either explicity with the \"scene\" property or implicitly with the default scene with name \"*\".\nThe Page inherits all the properties from the associated scene, including Elements. When the same property is specified both in the Page and the Scene, the value specified in the Page will be used. The only exception to this rule is Elements, which will be deep-merged (deep-inheritance). Elements with the id property will be merged, and other Elements will be appended (Elements defined in the Scene are always placed below Elements specified in the page).",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {},
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": []
}

schema.title: Scene
schema.description:
A Scene defines a set of properties and Elements to be shared among multile Pages. It also defines a background music to be played when one of those Pages is active.
A Page is always associated with a Scene, either explicity with the "scene" property or implicitly with the default scene with name "*".
The Page inherits all the properties from the associated scene, including Elements. When the same property is specified both in the Page and the Scene, the value specified in the Page will be used. The only exception to this rule is Elements, which will be deep-merged (deep-inheritance). Elements with the id property will be merged, and other Elements will be appended (Elements defined in the Scene are always placed below Elements specified in the page).

        "type": "string"

        "description": "The INSDC type of the sequence",
        "enum": [
          "RNase_MRP_RNA",
          "RNase_P_RNA",
          "SRP_RNA",
          "Y_RNA",
          "antisense_RNA",
          "autocatalytically_spliced_intron",

          "lncRNA",
          "miRNA",

          "ncRNA",
          "other",
          "piRNA",

          "snoRNA",
          "tRNA",
          "telomerase_RNA",
          "tmRNA",
          "vault_RNA"

      },
      "rnacentral_id": {
        "description": "The specific specific URS of the sequence in RNAcentral",
        "pattern": "^URS[A-Z0-9]{10}_\\d+$",
        "type": "string"

      "sequence": {

        "minLength": 10,
        "pattern": "^[ACGTYRWSKMDVHBNXFI]+$",
        "type": "string"

        "description": "A list of cross references that other databases can use. These will only be the 'high quality' references from RNAcentral.",
        "items": {

}

schema.title: Blockchain Certificates Receipt Schema, Version 1.2
schema.description: Provides evidence of the certificate on the blockchain, using the chainpoint v2 standard

@context.description: This should always be chainpoint v2 JSON LD context

type.description: type of hash. Currently the only supported hash type is SHA256, with chainpoint type ChainpointSHA256v2.

targetHash.description: hash of item being verified. Currently the only supported hash type is SHA256, and the targetHash format is validated accordingly.

merkleRoot.description: Merkle root value -- this is anchored to the blockchain. Currently the only supported hash type is SHA256, and merkleRoot format is validated accordingly.

proof.description: how to walk the Merkle tree from the target item to the Merkle root

left.description: value of left neighbor to combine into parent hash. Currently the only supported hash type is SHA256, and this value format is validated accordingly.

right.description: value of right neighbor to combine into parent hash. Currently the only supported hash type is SHA256, and this value format is validated accordingly.

anchors.description: how the proof is anchored to the blockchain

type.description: type of anchor, e.g. BTCOpReturn. Currently the only supported value is BTCOpReturn.

sourceId.description: How to lookup the proof on the blockchain. Currently this is expected to be the (value of the) Bitcoin transaction id, and this value format is validated accordingly

@list.description: Used to express an ordered set of data.

@set.description: Used to express an unordered set of data and to ensure that values are always represented as arrays.

title.description: The page's full name (including namespace prefix)

redirect.description: Redirected to page name.  Otherwise, null.

restrictions.description: The protection restrictions applied to this page.

user.description: Metadata about the user who saved the edit.  Might be null if the contributor information was deleted.

text.description: The user's user_name if registered or the IP address if anon.

comment.description: The revision summary.  Might be null if the summary was deleted.

text.description: The content of the revision.  Might be null if the revision content was deleted.

bytes.description: The size of revision content in bytes

sha1.description: A sha1 hash of the revision content

parent_id.description: The revision ID of the preceding revision

deleted.description: Represents information about the deleted/suppressed status of a revision and it’s associated data.

text.description: Is the text of this revision deleted/suppressed?

comment.description: Is the comment of this revision deleted/suppressed?

user.description: Is the user of this revision deleted/suppressed?

output:
The result is a RevisionDocument (v0.0.4) object, built to the given schema. It contains id, timestamp, page, user, minor, comment, text, bytes, sha1, parent_id, model, format and deleted, each with the type the schema requires.

- `id` — number.
- `timestamp` — string.
- `page` — object.
- `user` — object.
- `minor` — boolean.
- `comment` — string.
- `text` — string.
- `bytes` — number.
- `sha1` — string.
- `parent_id` — number.
- the remaining 3 fields follow the schema too.

The resulting JSON object follows:

{"id": 12345, "timestamp": "2022-01-01T12:00:00Z", "page": {"id": 1, "namespace": 1, "title": "Main Page", "redirect": null, "restrictions": ["edit"]}, "user": {"id": 123, "text": "John Doe"}, "minor": false, "comment": "Initial edit", "text": "This is the initial edit.", "bytes": 1024, "sha1": "abc123", "parent_id": null, "model": "default", "format": "markdown", "deleted": {"text": false, "comment": false, "user": false, "restricted": false}}
